deviations.what: the sap.m.ExpandableText control (since UI5 1.87) is newer than 1.71 and is the whole point of this sample - kept 1:1, the app needs a UI5 release >= 1.87.
ExpandableText.overflowMode (since UI5 1.87, enum sap.m.ExpandableTextOverflowMode InPlace/Popover) is bound per row as in the original.
Table.autoPopinMode (since UI5 1.76) is kept 1:1 - the app needs a UI5 release >= 1.87 anyway for the control.

the controller's onInit products are seeded in model_init verbatim; the shared Lorem ipsum tail of the four attribute1 texts is held once in a local and appended, the resulting strings are byte-identical to the original's.
